lines.zh: 我用四条腿走，骨头在地上敲。
lines.en: I walk on four legs, bones tapping the ground.

lines.zh: 我跳过墓碑，落地几乎没有声音。
lines.en: I leap the gravestone and land almost silently.

lines.zh: 复生后腿更轻，我走得比活着快。
lines.en: Reborn, my legs are lighter; I move faster than alive.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴只剩一串小骨头，还会摆。
lines.en: My tail is a string of small bones, and it still sways.

lines.zh: 我沿着重生锚的边绕圈，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I circle the respawn anchor, again and again.

lines.zh: 我在夜里穿过坟场，眼睛是两点亮。
lines.en: I cross the graveyard at night, eyes two sparks.

lines.zh: 骨头摩擦的声音，是我走路的方式。
lines.en: The rasp of bone is how I walk now.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚边走，脚步跟得很紧。
lines.en: I walk by your feet, keeping very close.

lines.zh: 我跳过栅栏，落进你家院子。
lines.en: I hop the fence and drop into your yard.

lines.zh: 我不再需要踩实，骨头太轻了。
lines.en: I no longer need firm footing; the bones are light.

lines.zh: 我走三步停一下，确认你在后面。
lines.en: I take three steps, pause, and check you follow.

lines.zh: 我穿过草丛，草叶从肋骨间穿过去。
lines.en: I cross the grass, blades passing through my ribs.

lines.zh: 我坐着，用后爪挠自己的肋骨。
lines.en: I sit and scratch my ribs with a hind paw.

lines.zh: 我没有毛了，风直接吹进骨头里。
lines.en: My fur is gone; wind blows straight through the bone.

lines.zh: 我想舔爪子，可舌头也没有了。
lines.en: I try to lick my paw, but my tongue is gone too.

lines.zh: 我对着月亮张嘴，发不出呼噜。
lines.en: I open my mouth at the moon and cannot purr.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会再来的喂食时间。
lines.en: I wait for a feeding time that will not come.

lines.zh: 我的项圈没了，脖子上只剩骨头。
lines.en: My collar is gone; only bone rings my neck.

lines.zh: 我蹲在窗台上，习惯还没有改。
lines.en: I crouch on the windowsill out of old habit.

lines.zh: 我听见老鼠，可我已经不想抓了。
lines.en: I hear a mouse, and no longer want to hunt.

lines.zh: 复活的地方有股烧焦的石头味。
lines.en: The place I revived smells of scorched stone.

lines.zh: 我安静地待着，骨头在慢慢响。
lines.en: I wait quietly while my bones creak slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼眶是空的。
lines.en: I look up at you with empty sockets.

lines.zh: 你蹲下叫我名字，我听见了。
lines.en: You crouch and say my name, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，等你伸过来。
lines.en: I watch your hand, waiting for it to reach me.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔早没了，可我还是在看你。
lines.en: My pupils are long gone, yet I still watch you.

lines.zh: 你眼里有难过，我看不懂那是什么。
lines.en: There is sorrow in your eyes; I cannot read it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，眼皮早就不在了。
lines.en: I blink slowly, though my lids are gone.

lines.zh: 我侧头听你说话，耳朵只是骨头。
lines.en: I tilt my head to listen; my ears are only bone.

lines.zh: 你叫我乖猫，我的尾巴动了一下。
lines.en: You call me a good cat, and my tail twitches.

lines.zh: 我记得你的气味，虽然鼻子没了。
lines.en: I remember your scent, though my nose is gone.

lines.zh: 我看着你很久，久到你转过头。
lines.en: I stare until you are the one who turns away.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过来，只为看清你的脸。
lines.en: I come over only to see your face clearly.

lines.zh: 你哭的时候，我坐得离你近一点。
lines.en: When you cry, I sit a little closer.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在夜里反光，像还活着。
lines.en: My eyes catch light at night, as if still alive.

lines.zh: 你摸我头顶，我什么都没感觉到。
lines.en: You pet my head; I feel nothing at all.

lines.zh: 你砍我，落下的是一块碎骨。
lines.en: You cut me, and a chip of bone falls.

lines.zh: 我掉了血，伤却不会结痂。
lines.en: I lose health, and the wound will not scab.

lines.zh: 骨头裂了，我用三条腿站着。
lines.en: A bone cracks; I stand on three legs.

lines.zh: 我不疼，只是有一块松了。
lines.en: No pain, only one piece come loose.

lines.zh: 猫有九条命，我用到第十条了。
lines.en: A cat has nine lives; I am on my tenth.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的尾巴骨。
lines.en: That blow snapped my tail bones.

lines.zh: 我退开两步，又走回你面前。
lines.en: I retreat two steps, then come back to you.

lines.zh: 你打我时，骨头的声音很响。
lines.en: When you hit me, the bones ring loudly.

lines.zh: 我没法被治好，你砍吧。
lines.en: I cannot be healed; keep swinging.

lines.zh: 血早没了，只有碎屑落下来。
lines.en: The blood is long gone; only dust falls.

lines.zh: 你拿着鱼，我的胃早就没了。
lines.en: You hold out fish; my stomach is long gone.

lines.zh: 生鱼的味道我认得，只是不想吃。
lines.en: I know the smell of raw fish, and do not want it.

lines.zh: 你把鱼放下，我闻了闻石头。
lines.en: You set the fish down, and I sniff the stone.

lines.zh: 我以前为一条鱼能跑半个村子。
lines.en: I once ran half the village for one fish.

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬了一下，鱼从骨缝里掉了。
lines.en: I bite once and the fish slips through my ribs.

lines.zh: 你晃着鱼逗我，我配合着看。
lines.en: You dangle the fish; I play along and watch.

lines.zh: 饿是活猫的事，我现在只剩习惯。
lines.en: Hunger belongs to the living; I keep only the habit.

lines.zh: 鱼在你手里，我更在意你的手。
lines.en: The fish is in your hand; the hand interests me more.

lines.zh: 我不吃，可你喂我时我还是靠近。
lines.en: I do not eat, but I still come close when you offer.

lines.zh: 这条鱼会烂，我不会。
lines.en: This fish will rot, and I will not.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴骨，我回头看你。
lines.en: You step on my tail bones, and I look back.

lines.zh: 我蹭你的腿，骨头硌得你一跳。
lines.en: I rub your leg, and the bone makes you flinch.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我轻得像空壳。
lines.en: We bump, and I am light as an empty shell.

lines.zh: 我钻过你的腿间，肋骨刮到裤子。
lines.en: I slip between your legs, ribs scraping your trousers.

lines.zh: 你把我抱起来，我比记忆里轻。
lines.en: You lift me, and I am lighter than you remember.

lines.zh: 我挡在你脚前，不让你往坟场走。
lines.en: I block your feet, keeping you from the graveyard.

lines.zh: 我撞开你的手，因为那里有把铲子。
lines.en: I butt your hand away; there is a shovel in it.

lines.zh: 你推我，我滑了一步，又回来。
lines.en: You push me; I slide a step and return.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子坐下，骨头很硬。
lines.en: I sit against your boot, all hard bone.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边挤过去，没让路。
lines.en: I squeeze past your legs without giving way.

lines.zh: 我连心跳都没有，谈什么配对。
lines.en: I have no heartbeat; what pairing is left for me?

lines.zh: 复活把我身上能生的东西都烧掉了。
lines.en: The revival burned away everything that could bear life.

lines.zh: 别把我跟别的猫放在一起了。
lines.en: Do not put me with other cats anymore.

lines.zh: 我不会再生小猫，只会再站起来。
lines.en: I will not birth kittens, only stand up again.

lines.zh: 你想让我有个伴，可我已经不是猫。
lines.en: You want me company, but I am not a cat now.

lines.zh: 这项圈本来该给下一只猫。
lines.en: This collar was meant for the next cat.

lines.zh: 我的骨头里留不住任何活的东西。
lines.en: Nothing living can stay inside these bones.

lines.zh: 墓地里没有谁能陪我走完一圈。
lines.en: No one in the graveyard walks a full circle with me.

lines.zh: 配对是暖的事，我是凉的。
lines.en: Pairing is a warm thing; I am cold.

lines.zh: 你替我记着就好，我不需要后代。
lines.en: You remember for me; I need no offspring.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起项圈，放在你脚边。
lines.en: I carry the collar in my teeth and set it at your feet.

lines.zh: 鱼我拖回来了，虽然吃不下。
lines.en: I dragged the fish back, though I cannot eat it.

lines.zh: 我叼着你的手套，走了半个院子。
lines.en: I carry your glove halfway across the yard.

lines.zh: 骨头太轻，捡东西时总掉。
lines.en: My bones are light; things keep slipping when I pick them up.

lines.zh: 我把老鼠放在门口，还是老样子。
lines.en: I leave a mouse at the door, same as always.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根羽毛，那是鹦鹉的。
lines.en: I pick up a feather; it belonged to the parrot.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西我都叼回来，一件不落。
lines.en: I fetch whatever you drop, not missing one.

lines.zh: 我咬住绳子，把箱子拖到你面前。
lines.en: I bite the rope and drag the chest to you.

lines.zh: 我叼来自己的项圈，放在墓碑上。
lines.en: I bring my own collar and lay it on the stone.

lines.zh: 我把骨头堆好，像在整理玩具。
lines.en: I stack the bones as if tidying my toys.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那只兔子，腿先动。
lines.en: I fix on that rabbit; my legs move first.

lines.zh: 有东西在草里动，我立刻低下了头。
lines.en: Something moves in the grass, and I lower my head.

lines.zh: 我锁定的目标，跑得再快也没用。
lines.en: Once I lock on, running fast will not save it.

lines.zh: 我闻不到它，可我看得见它。
lines.en: I cannot smell it, but I can see it.

lines.zh: 复活后我更快，猎物还没反应过来。
lines.en: Reborn, I am faster; the prey has not noticed.

lines.zh: 那只鸡离我六格，已经够了。
lines.en: The chicken is six blocks away; that is enough.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，骨头贴着地面。
lines.en: I flatten myself, bones close to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的目标是活的，我不是。
lines.en: My target is alive; I am not.

lines.zh: 我选最小的那只，因为追得上。
lines.en: I pick the smallest one, because I can catch it.

lines.zh: 目标确定，我不再叫了。
lines.en: Target set; I stop making any sound.

lines.zh: 它转头看我，我就知道该动了。
lines.en: It turns to look at me, and I know it is time.

lines.zh: 我把爪子扣进土里，等一个瞬间。
lines.en: I dig my claws in and wait for one moment.

lines.zh: 你养的东西，也会变成我的目标。
lines.en: What you keep may become my target too.

lines.zh: 我锁住它的时候，整个世界都安静。
lines.en: When I lock on, the whole world goes quiet.

lines.zh: 草尖一动，我的耳朵先转过去。
lines.en: A grass tip moves, and my ear turns first.

lines.zh: 我伏在草丛里，尾巴骨一动不动。
lines.en: I lie in the grass, my tail bones perfectly still.

lines.zh: 距离四格，我再等两下呼吸。
lines.en: Four blocks out; I wait two more breaths.

lines.zh: 它开始跑，我立刻追上去。
lines.en: It starts to run, and I am after it at once.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，把它往墙边赶。
lines.en: I circle it, herding it toward the wall.

lines.zh: 我跑起来骨头响，可我比它快。
lines.en: My bones rattle as I run, but I am faster.

lines.zh: 它钻进洞里，我在洞口守着。
lines.en: It slips into a burrow; I keep watch at the mouth.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫会把它吓跑。
lines.en: I stay silent; a cry would scare it off.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着它的脖子。
lines.en: I keep my gaze fixed on its neck.

lines.zh: 它跳上栅栏，我跟着跳上去。
lines.en: It leaps onto the fence, and I leap after it.

lines.zh: 我把它逼到角落，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I corner it and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在石头上，没有声音。
lines.en: My paws cross the stone without a sound.

lines.zh: 它喘得厉害，我一点都不喘。
lines.en: It pants hard; I do not pant at all.

lines.zh: 你喊我停下，我停了一瞬。
lines.en: You call me to stop, and I stop for a moment.

lines.zh: 我离它只剩一步，然后扑了。
lines.en: One step from it, and then I pounce.

lines.zh: 我从高处下来，落地前就张了爪。
lines.en: I come off the ledge, claws out before landing.

lines.zh: 它往门口跑，我早在那儿。
lines.en: It runs for the doorway. I am already there.

lines.zh: 我把呼吸压住，等它再近一格。
lines.en: I still my breath and wait for one more block.

lines.zh: 它回头看，正好看见我的骨头。
lines.en: It looks back and sees my bones.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，前爪先落在它背上。
lines.en: I pounce, front claws landing on its back.

lines.zh: 骨头做的爪子比活时更利。
lines.en: Bone claws cut deeper than living ones did.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的脖子，牙齿很凉。
lines.en: I bite its neck, and my teeth are cold.

lines.zh: 这一爪下去，它就不再动了。
lines.en: One swipe, and it stops moving.

lines.zh: 我打得不重，可伤口好不了。
lines.en: My blow is light, but the wound will not heal.

lines.zh: 它挣开跑了两步，我又按住了。
lines.en: It breaks free for two steps; I pin it again.

lines.zh: 我撕开它的皮，没有血溅到我。
lines.en: I tear its hide, and no blood splashes on me.

lines.zh: 我咬的时候，下颌骨咔了一声。
lines.en: My jaw clicks as I bite down.

lines.zh: 它踢我，我的肋骨凹了一下。
lines.en: It kicks me, and one rib dents inward.

lines.zh: 我打完抬头看你，等你点头。
lines.en: When it is done I look up, waiting for your nod.

lines.zh: 这一击是为我自己，不为饿。
lines.en: This strike is for me, not for hunger.

lines.zh: 我把猎物拖到你脚边，放下。
lines.en: I drag the kill to your feet and drop it.

lines.zh: 它还想跑，我一爪按住它尾巴。
lines.en: It tries to flee; I pin its tail with one claw.

lines.zh: 我出手总比活着时快半拍。
lines.en: I strike half a beat faster than I did alive.

lines.zh: 我一爪拍在它后腿，它歪倒了。
lines.en: A paw to its hind leg, and it tipped over.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙齿磕在一起。
lines.en: I bite down, and my teeth click together.

lines.zh: 重生锚的光一亮，我从土里爬出。
lines.en: The anchor flares, and I claw up out of the dirt.

lines.zh: 我第二次睁眼，世界是灰的。
lines.en: I open my eyes a second time, and the world is grey.

lines.zh: 坟场的土松了，我钻了出来。
lines.en: The graveyard soil loosens, and I dig my way out.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己是怎么死的。
lines.en: I do not remember how I died.

lines.zh: 骨头先拼好，皮最后也没有长回来。
lines.en: The bones pieced together; skin never returned.

lines.zh: 我从充能的锚边站起来，很轻。
lines.en: I rise beside the charged anchor, very light.

lines.zh: 石碑上刻着名字，那是我。
lines.en: There is a name on the stone, and it is mine.

lines.zh: 夜里坟场的雾散了，我在雾里。
lines.en: The graveyard mist thins at night, and I am in it.

lines.zh: 这次复活，我的爪子先动。
lines.en: This time I wake, and my claws move first.

lines.zh: 我在同一个地方醒了两回。
lines.en: I have woken in the same place twice.

lines.zh: 主人给我留的窝，积了土。
lines.en: The bed my owner left me has filled with dirt.

lines.zh: 我走出来，项圈留在了土里。
lines.en: I walk out, and my collar stays in the earth.

lines.zh: 复生没有问我要不要。
lines.en: The revival never asked whether I wanted it.

lines.zh: 我回来得比上次快，也更冷。
lines.en: I came back faster than last time, and colder.

lines.zh: 火燎过骨头，冒出一股焦味。
lines.en: Fire licks the bone and leaves a burnt smell.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，我散了两块骨头。
lines.en: Falling, I scatter two bones loose.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，骨头比水重。
lines.en: I sink; the bones are heavier than water.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀飞我，落地又拼回来。
lines.en: The blast flings me off, and I land reassembled.

lines.zh: 箭穿进肋骨之间，卡住了。
lines.en: An arrow slips between my ribs and sticks.

lines.zh: 治疗的光落在我身上，没有用。
lines.en: Healing light falls on me and does nothing.

lines.zh: 我不会饿死，只会越来越轻。
lines.en: I will not starve; I only grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷劈过骨头，我发了一会儿抖。
lines.en: Lightning runs through the bones and I shake a while.

lines.zh: 虚空里我散成骨头，还往上看。
lines.en: In the void I come apart, still looking up.
